about: Shows slides a page at a time in a scroller that snaps: triggers move a page, dots pick one, and a rotation control starts and stops a carousel that plays by itself. Rotation stops when keyboard focus enters, pauses under the pointer and does not start by itself under reduced motion.

cards.about: Two cards a page, one card a move, with `slidesPerPage` and `slidesPerMove`. A card out of view is inert, so its button leaves the tab order. The triggers are `aria-disabled` at the ends and keep focus.
cards.title: Two cards a page

controlled.about: `page` and `onPageChange` keep the carousel and the segment group above it on the same picture.
controlled.title: Controlled page

controls.about: The controls beside the slides, or over them on `bg.panel` pills.
controls.title: Controls

gallery.about: Pictures with the triggers and the dots over them, looping, and draggable with the mouse. Focus the scroller or a dot and use the arrow keys, Home and End.
gallery.title: Gallery

pictures.dunes: Orange dunes under a pale sky
pictures.peaks: Snowy peaks under a blue sky

radius.about: The slides' corners, from the tightest to the roundest.
radius.title: Corners

ratio.about: The scroller's aspect ratio. A picture that is a slide's child covers the slide.
ratio.title: Ratios

rotation.about: `autoplay` rotates every 5 seconds. The rotation control comes first, keyboard focus entering the carousel stops the rotation, the pointer pauses it, and reduced motion keeps it still until the reader starts it.
rotation.title: Rotation

title: Carousel

vertical.about: `orientation="vertical"`: the slides run top to bottom in a scroller of the `landscape` ratio, and the up and down keys move a page.
vertical.title: Vertical
